title: Here's How to Create Content AI Actually Cites
description:
The content AI actually cites is already mapped out.

Blogs that answer real questions. Listicles. "Best tool for X" comparisons. FAQ pages.

Those are your highest-lift targets. You're fixing one or making one.

Here's the process:

STEP 1 - GET THE RULEBOOK:
Copy Decision 1 from the guide. It's the spark notes of the new content rulebook. Answers up front. Match real buyer questions. Keep passages liftable.

STEP 2 - PICK YOUR PATH:

PATH A - REWRITE EXISTING:
Got a page that performs? Paste it in with Decision 1. Have it rewritten to those rules.

PATH B - START FROM SCRATCH:
Tell the chat your niche. Have it write a citation-ready page from the ground up.

STEP 3 - PROOF IN YOUR VOICE:
Always push back. Make sure it sounds like you before it goes live. AI writes the structure. You write the thinking.

STEP 4 - DEPLOY:
Put it somewhere. Your own site or spin one up quick with Lovable or HubSpot's landing page builder. Attach your domain.

That's it. Citation-ready content live.

#AEOStrategy #AISearch #ContentStrategy #CitationOptimization #DigitalMarketing #SEOStrategy

top_comments.author: @emekaudeogu
top_comments.text: How about publishing on sites like Medium, Vocal, or Substack with links back to marketing/sales assets you own?

top_reply.author: @HubSpotMarketing
top_reply.text: Really solid strategy. Publishing on those platforms builds topical authority and creates pathways back to your owned assets. The key is making the content genuinely useful on those platforms rather than just a thin teaser. Worth including as a layer in your AI citation strategy.
